_comment: Tool-neutral definition of the checks. NOT an import file for Uptime Kuma or Better Stack (their import schemas differ and were not verified); copy the values into the UI, or let check.sh run them. Replace lms.example.com and the sample codes.

json_assertions.note: "degraded" should alert too, but as a warning
wp-cron every minute; certificates target < 60 s

monitors.name: Certificate verify page
monitors.note: Use a real issued code (https://lms.example.com/verify/ABCDE12345) with keyword set to the 'valid' wording once one exists in production. Cached by Cloudflare, so this proves the edge, not the origin; the health check proves the origin.

monitors.name: Lesson page
monitors.note: Point at one public/preview lesson. A logged-out visitor to a members-only lesson may get a redirect (302) to login: assert that instead if no public lesson exists.
